### Other changes

* no more ghost ([a42529a](https://github.com/roshbhatia/sysinit/commit/a42529a1b7f83e0bd26a62b227d29fc7a7a47b38))
* no more ghost ([a177d96](https://github.com/roshbhatia/sysinit/commit/a177d96513f9e00135c08b4adf442cef92436954))


### refactor

* remove ghostty/zellij, add direnv-instant ([72352d3](https://github.com/roshbhatia/sysinit/commit/72352d3bba3554b97049887596e661eea1a97ecd))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* - Remove Ghostty terminal configuration
- Remove Zellij multiplexer configuration
- WezTerm is now the only terminal emulator

Features:
- Integrate direnv-instant for faster nix-direnv loads
- Clean up VM library to remove zellij references

Performance:
- direnv-instant caches evaluation results for faster cd
